headline: LINDSAY CLANCY 🧑‍⚖️ COURT 🏛️ DRAMA as Lawyer TRIES 🍆 to DISMISS Murder Case
text:
LINDSAY 🧍‍♀️ CLANCY 👩‍⚕️ finally 🏁 appeared in COURT 🏛️ for the FIRST 🥇 time since her MURDER 🔪 trial fell apart earlier this MONTH 📅 and her DEFENCE 🛡️ lawyer is now PUSHING 👐 hard to get the whole CASE 📋 dismissed so she can be CLEARED 🧼 of murdering her THREE 3️⃣ children in 2023 but PROSECUTORS 👮‍♀️ are fighting back claiming the STATE 🇺🇸 already proved her GUILT 🩸!! Clancy has been locked away in a PSYCHIATRIC 🏥 facility ever since the KILLINGS 🪦 and her team swears it was severe POSTPARTUM 🤰 psychosis that made her do it while the other side insists the slayings were totally INTENTIONAL 🎯!!

Her DEFENCE 🛡️ squad on TUESDAY 📅 argued the JUDGE 👨‍⚖️ should just DISMISS 📤 the entire case but the PROSECUTORS 👮‍♀️ hit back saying the STATE 🇺🇸 had already MET 📏 its burden in proving her guilt so no way are they letting her walk free after what she did to those poor BABIES 👶!! Clancy 36 🪪 does not even DENY 🙅‍♀️ killing her three little ONES 1️⃣2️⃣3️⃣ but her lawyers claim she was deep in the throes of POSTPARTUM 🤰 psychosis at the time while the prosecutors keep hammering that the KILLINGS 🪦 were straight up INTENTIONAL 🎯 with zero excuses!! It is still not clear if she will even FACE 😣 a retrial because the request to DISMISS 📤 the case will be hashed out at a hearing on 2 NOVEMBER 🗓️ Judge William Sullivan announced!!

One of the MOTIONS 🏋️‍♂️ tackled on Tuesday came from Clancy's LAWYER 🧑‍⚖️ Kevin Reddington who begged for her to be found NOT ❌ guilty under Rule 25 which is that Massachusetts move that says a defendant should walk if the prosecutors did not argue their case EFFECTIVELY 💪!! Reddington also dropped a brand NEW 🆕 defence claiming there was simply not enough EVIDENCE 🔎 to prove Clancy actually killed her own CHILDREN 👦👧👶 which is a total flip from how he played the trial before when he was all about her MENTAL 🧠 health and begging the jury to find her not criminally RESPONSIBLE 🧾 because of the postpartum PSYCHOSIS 🤯!!

This entire CASE 📋 is based on SPECULATION 🧐 he declared out loud in court which is a massive change of argument from the defence lawyer who during the actual TRIAL ⚖️ focused only on Clancy's mental HEALTH 🏥 urging the jury to find her not criminally responsible because of it and now he is coming in swinging with this brand new ANGLE 📐 that there is not enough evidence at all!! Prosecutor Shanan Buckingham called Reddington's whole argument straight up LAUGHABLE 😂 and said the state prosecutors had presented NUMEROUS 🔢 pieces of evidence showing Clancy was in a perfectly HEALTHY 😊 mental state at the time of the murders during the trial so they definitely MET 📏 their burden!!

She argued Clancy KNEW 🧠 exactly what she was doing when she killed her three CHILDREN 👦👧👶 Cora five 5️⃣ Dawson three 3️⃣ and Callan who was eight MONTHS 📆 old right there in their Massachusetts HOME 🏠 and that there is no way this was some accident caused by postpartum PSYCHOSIS 🤰 because the evidence shows she was fully AWARE 👀!! Judge Sullivan pushed back HARD 💪 when both Reddington and Buckingham refused to agree to his suggestion that they might lock in a possible RETRIAL 📅 date right now ahead of the hearing saying he wanted to get this thing MOVING 🏃‍♂️ so both sides better come prepared to discuss possible trial dates at the November hearing or else!!

Reddington said he would be totally UNABLE 🚫 to go to trial until at least JUNE ☀️ if the case is retried and District Attorney Timothy Cruz told reporters outside after court that the prosecutors have not yet DECIDED 🤔 if they are going to retry Clancy on the murder CHARGES ⚖️ because they are still doing their due DILIGENCE 📋 and will continue doing that since this case is really all about the CHILDREN 👦👧 and what happened to them!! Following a full WEEK 📅 of deliberations earlier this month a Massachusetts jury told Sullivan they could not reach a VERDICT 🗳️ because of one lone HOLDOUT 🧍‍♂️ juror and that is exactly why a mistrial was declared on 4 SEPTEMBER 🗓️ leaving everyone wondering what comes NEXT ➡️ for Lindsay Clancy and her defence team!!
